## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The base assignment evaluates a straight prismatic member under static loading. Member self-weight, local contact stress, fastener details, lateral instability, technician motion, impact, vibration, fatigue, material nonlinearity, and regulatory or workplace-access design requirements are intentionally excluded.
